description: Expected SHA-256 values (R1.6) of the seven allowlisted files, with CRLF and lone CR replaced by LF. The expected values were computed by a different tool chain from the code under test: perl (s/\r\n?/\n/g) piped to sha256sum, inside the approved toolchain container with --network none, on 2026-11-12. The reference builder tests/legacy-sample/lib/ai-input-builder.ps1 (New-AiInputBundle) produced the same hashes and character counts on the same day; it is a cross-check and not the source of these values. If a legacy file changes, this test fails on purpose: the allowlisted input changed and the hashes must be reviewed against R1.6, not copied from any tool.
